nl.title: DKIM-record toevoegen aan DNS domeinnaam
nl.excerpt: Schakel DKIM in DirectAdmin in en controleer het DNS TXT-record voor betere mailaflevering.
nl.bodyHtml:
DKIM ondertekent uitgaande mail. In DirectAdmin activeer je dit per domein; het TXT-record moet in DNS staan.

Voorbereiding

  • Domein geselecteerd
  • DNS-beheer (DA of extern)

Stappen

  1. Selecteer domein
  2. E-mail Accounts / E-mail Authentication → enable DKIM
  3. Controleer DNS Zone of externe DNS op x._domainkey TXT
  4. Verstuur testmail en check header dkim=pass

Controleren

  • DKIM enabled in panel
  • dkim=pass in headers

Tip: Externe DNS (Cloudflare): kopieer het record handmatig.

Let op: Meerdere conflicterende DKIM-selectors breken validatie.

Kom je er na deze stappen niet uit? Open een ticket bij TripleZero iT via het klantenpanel. Vermeld hostname, DirectAdmin-gebruikersnaam (geen wachtwoord), domein en wat je al probeerde.

Gerelateerd: create-mailbox; spamassassin.

en.title: Add DKIM record to DNS domain name
en.excerpt: Add DKIM record to DNS domain name: steps in DNS management (client panel or Zone Editor) for dkim, record, DNS.
en.bodyHtml:
Add DKIM record to DNS domain name is solved via DNS management (client panel or Zone Editor). Below are concrete steps for dkim, record, DNS, including verification afterwards.

Preparation

  • Access to DNS management (client panel or Zone Editor)
  • Focus of this article: dkim, record, DNS
  • Note of the current setting/status

Steps

  1. Go to DNS management (client panel or Zone Editor). Keep this article (“Add DKIM record to DNS domain name”) beside you so you only make the intended change.
  2. Open DNS management for the correct domain; export/screenshot the zone.
  3. Change only records that belong to dkim / record (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS).
  4. Save; wait for TTL/propagation.
  5. Verify with an external lookup; then test site or mail.
  6. Document what you changed around dkim, record, DNS (old → new value) for support.

Verify

  • Result for dkim, record, DNS matches “Add DKIM record to DNS domain name”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside dkim record toevoegen aan
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get dkim, record, DNS right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if dkim, record, DNS touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: DNS management (client panel or Zone Editor), backups, tickets.
